enumeration_basis: Receipt-row enumeration of selected indices; physical records in table order only
exclusions: asset payload extraction/decryption/decompression or archive installation
client lookup winner, publisher application priority or duplicate suppression
map payload availability, render, ordinary play, 82-gap closure or full-game coverage
helper_policy: May execute only separately verified exact bytes; no October production contract/global mutation; manifest identifies whether executed. No helper execution is required.

input_manifest.ledger_requirement: Typed equality with all 59 profile ledger rows; source_evidence equality with profile; no host identities, absolute paths, raw member names or oracle outputs

output.record_schema: unchanged core.render_record dictionary and canonical ASCII JSONL; archive is original GPF name, not downloaded storage basename
output.source_join: manifest archive index/source LF/storage path/original name/full SHA -> fixed numeric records filename
output.tail_policy: Core may report tails; this exact production profile requires observed zero tails. A nonzero tail is profile mismatch, not universal format invalidity.

source_evidence_access: Provenance pins only; worker input is normalized manifest. Original private receipts/admission/header observations and root oracle are not worker-readable.

source_rules.meaning: Existing pinned source semantics; no new native binary/source parity claim
